# independent re-verification: load, check, run with fresh modules; count nodes
from language import load, validate
from checker import check
from interpreter import run
text = open('/app/witness.json').read()
p = load(text)
print('nodes:', validate(p))
print('check:', check(p))
r = run(p)
print('status:', r['status'], '| steps:', r['steps'], '| msg:', r.get('message'))
assert r['status'] == 'type_error' and r['steps'] <= 4096
# determinism across repeated runs
for _ in range(3):
    assert run(load(text))['status'] == 'type_error'
print('OK')
EOF
